exact_blockers: The pinned ledger records dpdfnet2.onnx as 10,178,747 bytes with SHA-256 4f0ee28935b4a32abecc717d745416976565834d839601acf43031094b4dc94c, but model_revision is null and the download revision is the mutable 'main' with no retrieval-time commit, so an immutable artifact revision for those bytes is not established; the asset is absent from this SDK worktree.

The offline runtime is the external dpdfnet 0.6.0 CPU ONNX package. It is not installed here, has no pinned wheel/sdist digest in this worktree, and its runtime distribution and product-use terms beyond Apache-2.0 metadata are not cleared; no vendor runtime is invoked.

Apache-2.0 is recorded for the package and model card, but artifact-specific weight rights, training-data provenance, redistribution clearance and legal review are not established; no weight, runtime or upstream source may be vendored, packaged, downloaded or redistributed by this package.

No rights-cleared held-out real cohort, independent clean-reference scorer, listening result, target pacing/deadline measurement or approved exact whole-clip offline reference output exists; every release gate remains blocked.

notes: Every metric in this report is computed on a deterministic synthetic fixture and describes the surrogate only.
No DPDFNet-2 weight, package, runtime, output, corpus, device, listener or release artifact is used or claimed.
All timestamps are source-sample coordinates; no device, wall-clock, pacing or deadline measurement exists.
The offline boundary is whole-clip only: no incremental, streaming, flush or reset behavior is modelled.

offline_boundary.availability_model: sample-coordinate only; no wall clock, device clock or deadline

output_accounting.finding: The offline boundary returns exactly one output sample for every input sample. A partial final frame is zero-padded only to estimate its frame gain; padding is never returned and no flush or startup delay exists.

offline_boundary.protocol: caller-supplied external asset plus one complete whole-clip call
